# Test fixtures

`games_car_tb_2025.csv` — every 2025 regular-season game involving CAR or TB, copied unmodified from the
nflverse schedule file (whitelisted columns only; no market columns). It contains the permanent
January regression case **2025 Week 18, CAR @ TB, 2026-01-03** (season 2025, game_id `2025_18_CAR_TB`).
Correct pre-game 2025 records: CAR 8-8-0, TB 7-9-0. v1.0 wrongly reported 0-0-0 / 0-0-0 because it used
the calendar year (2026) as the season. Do not edit or delete this fixture.
